source.caution:
[판토텐산/비타민B2/비타민B1/비타민B12/비오틴]
1. 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것
[베타카로틴]
2. 흡연자는 섭취 시 전문가와 상담할 것
3. 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것
[비타민D]
4. 고칼슘혈증이 있거나 의약품 복용 시 전문가와 상담할 것
5. 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것
[비타민K]
6. 항응고제 등 복용 시 전문가와 상담할 것
7. 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것
[비타민C]
8. 과량 섭취하지 않도록 주의할 것
9. 신장질환이 있는 경우 섭취 전 전문가와 상담할 것
10. 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것 
[비타민B6]
11. 손발 따끔거림, 작열감 또는 저림 등의 이상사례 발생 시 섭취를 중단하고 전문가와 상담할 것

멀티비타민 아레스 포 맨Copper · Niacin · Magnesium · Manganese · Biotin · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Vitamin K · Selenium · Zinc · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장 · 2 times a day · 2 tablets

This product combines 0.45mg of Copper, 130mg of Niacin, 96mg of Magnesium, 1mg of Manganese, 60μg of Biotin, 1.26mg of Vitamin A, 10mg of Vitamin B1, 10μg of Vitamin B12, 14mg of Vitamin B2, 12mg of Vitamin B6, 150mg of Vitamin C, 5μg of Vitamin D, 20mg of Vitamin E, 23.4μg of Vitamin K, 16.5μg of Selenium, 11.3mg of Zinc, 557.6μg of Folate, 40mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (2 tablets): 0.45mg Copper, 130mg Niacin, 96mg Magnesium, 1mg Manganese, 60μg Biotin, 1.26mg Vitamin A, 10mg Vitamin B1, 10μg Vitamin B12, 14mg Vitamin B2, 12mg Vitamin B6, 150mg Vitamin C, 5μg Vitamin D, 20mg Vitamin E, 23.4μg Vitamin K, 16.5μg Selenium, 11.3mg Zinc, 557.6μg Folate, 40mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Copper
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the transport and utilisation of iron
  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Manganese
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin K
    • Needed for normal blood clotting
    • Needed for the structure of bone
  • Selenium
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
